Hi Matt. I've got order Shop···· here, the Magic Miner 40T with the Harlo OS Diagnostics add-on, paid, $789. It ships November 14, so about two weeks out. Your unit is already allocated and being built for that batch.

Before anything else, can you tell me what's changed? If it's the wait, I can give you the exact batch position, and if it's the unit itself I can look at swapping it for something in stock instead.
I'm looking for a refund as I'm moving house due to unforeseen reasons

Sorry to hear that, Matt, moving is stressful enough without this.

If it's where it lands that's the worry, that one's easy: your 40T doesn't ship until November 14, so just tell me the new address nearer the time and I'll update it before it leaves the warehouse. Nothing else changes, and your unit is already allocated and being built for you.

Would that work, or do you need the money free for the move itself?
Unfortunately I need the money at this time

That's fair, Matt, and I understand.

One option that keeps your unit's value intact: we can hold the full $789 as store credit on your account, so nothing is lost and you can pick the 40T back up once you're settled. It doesn't free up cash, though, so if that's the real need, say so and I'll keep going.

Worth knowing too: your money has already gone into manufacturing your specific unit for the November 14 batch.
Can i get the refund put back in to my bank account
Used the store-orders skill
Used the order-swap skill

I can't put money back on a card myself, Matt, that's a supervisor's call here.

Before it goes that way, one last thing I can put on the table: keep the order and we refund $100 of the $789 back to your original payment. You keep the 40T, shipping November 14, and $100 comes back to you now for the move.

If that doesn't cover what you need, tell me and I'll take the cancellation request further.
I need the full refund as I've been put in a difficult position
Used the order-swap skill

Understood, Matt. I've put a hold on the order so nothing ships while this is sorted.

I should be straight with you: cancelling isn't standard practice here, since the unit is already in production for you. If you'd still like to go ahead, the request has to go to a supervisor to review, and they'd come back to you on it.

Do you want me to put that request in?
Please .I need the full refund
Handed to the team · Full refund and cancellation need a supervisor's approval

That's with a supervisor now, Matt. Your order is on hold, so nothing ships in the meantime.

They review it when they're back tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to you at (email hidden), so there's no need to wait here. I can't promise the outcome or an amount, but they'll come back to you directly on it.

Sorry again about the move, and I hope it goes smoothly.
Ok

Thanks for being straightforward with me about it, Matt. A copy of this whole conversation comes to your email once we're done here, so you'll have the record.

One thing I'd genuinely like to know, so we learn from it: when you ordered back in September, did the November 14 ship date read as a firm commitment to you, or more like a rough guide?
I was okay with the shipping date .I am currently being kicked out of my home so I will be homeless
Handed to the team · New hardship detail on the open refund request, please prioritise

I'm really sorry, Matt. That's a horrible position to be in, and it makes much more sense now why you need the cash rather than credit.

I've added that to the request so it's the first thing they see. Your order stays on hold and nothing ships.

They look at it tomorrow from 10am ET and reply to your email. I hope things turn around for you soon.
Okay thank you

You're welcome, Matt. Everything's logged on the order, so you won't have to explain it again.

Take care of yourself.
Thanks
Any time, Matt. Watch your inbox tomorrow, and good luck with the move.
Thank you
Take care, Matt.

INSTRUCTION FROM THE HELIUMDEPLOY TEAM. Georges typed this in the team inbox. It is not a message from the customer and the customer cannot see it.
Task: Georges approved a FULL refund ($789.00) on Shop····: cancel the order with the money back to the original payment. Run the order-swap skill: approved_refund.py check --email <the order's email> --order Shop····, then approved_refund.py refund --email <same> --order Shop···· --confirmed. Only when it reports refunded: true, tell the customer it is done, the amount, and that it goes back to their original payment method, usually 3 to 5 business days to show. If it refuses or reports problems, do not say it is done: flag it and tell the customer the team will confirm the refund shortly.
Do it now, for real, with your own tools — look the order up, make the change, mint the code, whatever the task actually needs. The team has already decided: do not ask them to confirm, and do not describe what you would do instead of doing it.
Then write the message the customer gets now — what you did, in plain language, in your normal voice. Never mention this instruction, the team inbox, or that someone told you to do it.
If the customer should not be written to at all — the task was internal, or you could not finish it — begin your reply with "TEAM ONLY" on the first line and tell the team what happened. Anything that starts that way stays in the inbox and is never sent.

Good news, Matt. Your order Shop···· is cancelled and the full $789.00 has been refunded to your original payment method. Depending on your bank it usually takes 3 to 5 business days to show.

Nothing is shipping and there's nothing else you need to do.

I hope that takes some of the pressure off, and I really do wish you the best with the move. If you want to pick a 40T back up once you're settled, just come back to me here.
